# Create Scatter Chart

## Group (Subgroup)

Core (Visualization)

## Description

This **Filter** creates a scatter chart image from two input data arrays (X and Y) using the McPlotty charting library. The resulting chart is rendered as an RGBA image and stored in a new ImageGeometry.

The user can specify the chart title, axis titles, and the pixel dimensions of the output image. The output ImageGeometry will have dimensions of (Width x Height x 1) with a single cell data array containing RGBA (4-component uint8) pixel data.
